# AI Harness

> AI Harness is a model-independent agentic development environment: a control plane where AI coding agents understand projects, assemble bounded context, draft structured plans, request human approval, execute policy-controlled tools, verify their work, and leave a complete auditable trail. Fastify 5 API + BullMQ worker + Next.js 15 PWA + Bridge Gateway, Postgres 17 / Redis 7, npm-workspaces monorepo.

## Documentation

- [Getting Started](docs/getting-started.md): Install, run, and complete your first agent task in 30 minutes
- [Core Concepts](docs/concepts.md): Tasks, runs, the state machine, permissions, checkpoints, context budgets, model routing, events
- [Troubleshooting](docs/troubleshooting.md): Symptom → cause → fix diagnostics hub (install, database, API, worker, bridge, provider issues)
- [Examples](docs/examples/README.md): Eight worked recipes — bug fixes, plan approval, refactor with rollback, test loops, Ollama, MCP, checkpoints

## Guides

- [Permissions & Approvals](docs/guides/permissions-and-approvals.md): ALLOW/ASK/DENY pipeline, policies, expiring approvals, destructive-tool checkpoints, security scan gate
- [Context & Memory](docs/guides/context-and-memory.md): Budgeted context assembly, priority tiers, repo map, compaction, prompt-injection defenses, project memory
- [Models & Providers](docs/guides/models-and-providers.md): Encrypted provider credentials, supported adapters, stage-based model routing, fallbacks, cost and quota enforcement
- [Hooks & Events](docs/guides/hooks-and-events.md): Persist-first ordered events, afterSequence replay, lifecycle hooks, Prometheus metrics
- [MCP](docs/guides/mcp.md): Connect HTTP/SSE/STDIO Model Context Protocol servers, tool discovery, health checks, security gating
- [Self-Hosting](docs/guides/self-hosting.md): Single-node quickstart, production containers, env var reference, scaling, Terraform GCP stack
